# guide:search-guides — Guide Full-Text Search

## Rules

**GuideSearchPort** (driven, app)
- `search(query: string, options?: GuideSearchOptions): Promise<readonly GuideSearchHit[]>`
- Opts: `topic?` = 1 topic; `limit?` def 5; `snippetLines?` def 3 (per side of match).

**MiniSearch adapter** (infra) — implements port, indexes EVERY `GuideSection`
- Content from `GuideTopic.content` on the fly: `section.content ?? slice(startOffset,endOffset) ?? lines[startLine-1..endLine]`.
- Fields `id`,`topic`,`title`,`heading`,`sectionIndex`,`content` (code also `level`,`startLine`,`endLine`).
- `id` = `` `${guide.topic}#${section.index}` `` — topic-scoped, no collection scope.
- Boost `title` 5, `heading` 3, `content` 1. `prefix:true`, `fuzzy:0.2`. No index-level stop-word filter.

**Per-hit**
- `snippet` = line-numbered, `snippetLines` around BEST-MATCH line, not section start. Cache doc lines per topic to window across section bounds. Line score: exact full-query substring > significant term +word-boundary > prefix. Window `max(0,matchIdx-n)`..`min(docEnd,matchIdx+n)`, absolute 1-indexed. No term hits → start at `startLine`.
- `readCommand` = fetch section by sectionIndex/heading. Literal: `` `specd guide ${doc.topic} --section ${doc.sectionIndex}` `` — `specd guide` HARDCODED, not collection-derived.
- `file` = `` `${doc.topic}.md` `` — `.md` hardcoded, topic-only, no collection dir. In `GuideSearchHit`, absent from spec text.
- `section` = `section.heading`.

**SearchGuidesQuery** (app) — holds port. Empty/whitespace query → `[]`, no port call. Else delegate → ranked `GuideSearchHit[]`.

## Constraints
- Fully in-memory, no persistent DB. `minisearch`, zero external transitive deps.
- Topic filter: exact match post-search, normalized `.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\.md$/,)`. `limit<=0`→5; `snippetLines<0`→3.
- Punctuation, regex metachars, emoji, Unicode MUST NOT crash; all-stop-word query → empty/fallback, no throw.
- Collection gap (2nd catalog, e.g. `specd guide-sdk`): `id`, topic-line cache, `file`, `readCommand` all topic-only. Need collection namespace in `id` + collection-derived command, else `id` collides and `readCommand` emits wrong command.
